Not sure which Scandit product fits your use case?›

Install the Scandit plugin and use the `/data-capture-sdk`skill so that your AI coding agent can recommend the right product for your use case. [More info →](https://docs.scandit.com/sdks/ios/agent-skills)

Run the following command in your project directory. It detects the supported coding agents you have installed and adds the Scandit plugin to each. Re-run it to update.

```
npx plugins add scandit/skills
```

Prefer to set it up yourself? [Manual installation steps for each agent →](https://docs.scandit.com/sdks/ios/agent-skills#manual-installation)
